title: Hundreds of asylum seekers to be moved to two UK military sites
summary: Barracks in Inverness and East Sussex will house about 900 men as government aims to end use of hotels Hundreds of people seeking asylum in the UK will be moved to military sites as the government aims to end the use of hotels to house them. The Home Office confirmed that two barracks – Cameron barracks in Inverness and Crowborough training camp in East Sussex – would be used to house about 900 men temporarily. Officials are working to identify more sites. Continue reading...
